newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Arafat meets Jordan prime minister in Jericho.
newsitem.headline: Arafat meets Jordan prime minister in Jericho.

text.p: Jordan's Prime Minister Abdul-Karim al-Kabariti arrived in Palestinian-ruled Jericho on Thursday to discuss President Yasser Arafat's troubled peace moves with Israel, witnesses said.
"They are going to discuss the peace process...and the crisis over the delay in reaching an agreement on the Hebron issue," Arafat's adviser Nabil Abu Rdainah told Reuters on Wednesday.
For two months PLO and Israeli negotiators have been struggling to close a deal on implementing Israel's handover of most of the West Bank town of Hebron to the Palestinian Authority.

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu says he wants to change the Hebron accord to boost security for the 400 Jews living and studying in the heart of the city among more than 100,000 Palestinians.
Palestinians fear Netanyahu, a right-winger who ousted the previous government in May elections, wants to scrap peace moves based on giving up occupied Arab land for peace.

Under an interim PLO-Israel deal, Israel was to give the PLO self-rule in seven West Bank towns. It handed over six. The Hebron pullout was delayed by a wave of Moslem militant suicide bombings that killed 59 people in Israel in February and March.
